name: Deeply
description: The stories of love – and heartbreak – of various couples, from their memorable beginnings to their inevitable ends.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In 2011, Deniz and Barış meet and have an encounter full of adventure and passion. In 2021, divorce strikes, full of sadness and pain.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: 2012 and 2020, love and hate. In one of those years, they were madly in love, while in the other, they blatantly hated each other.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: 2013 and 2019. Two defining moments in their lives. In 2013, they got married. In 2019, Deniz lost her father.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: While 2014 was the year when they lived their dream life, 2018 was the year when reality hit them in the face.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: 2015 and 2017. Deniz and Barış live an endless day and an inifinite night, which are the breaking points of their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: 2016. A bittersweet and painful year in which Deniz gets pregnant. They both go through the purest, happiest, and most intense feelings.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: 2024. After the divorce, Barış tries to establish a new life and the future looks brighter for him.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: 2025. After the divorce, Deniz tries to build a new life, and sets out to break down the walls she has put up for years.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Nilüfer and Cihan's paths cross on a beach in 2014. Ten years later, the weight of their past experiences will be deeply felt.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After meeting each other's families in 2015 and gaining a understanding of their wounds and they using those very wounds to hurt each other in 2023.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: In 2016, Nilüfer and Cihan's wedding day arrives. Six years later, however, a loss brings the couple and those around them together once again.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: In 2017, Nilüfer takes an initiative for Cihan's career without informing him. In 2021, with Elif entering their lives, both of them become parents.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: In 2020, as Nilüfer tries to uncover the reason behind her daughter's unruliness, she finds herself venturing into unexpected places.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Both Nilüfer and Cihan will try to move on with their lives after each other.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In 2016, Güneş and Serkan fall in love at first sight. A decade later, the pair finds themselves on the brink of divorce.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: At a couples therapy session, Serkan and Güneş share their problems with communication, leading their therapist to suggest a new way to reconnect.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: On their wedding day, Güneş and Serkan discuss having children. Later, Serkan struggles to support Güneş's complicated pregnancy.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: An increasingly lonely Güneş attempts to support Serkan during a tumultuous period of personal and professional setbacks.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: During COVID lockdown, Kerem ices out his parents. Later, amid their own issues, Güneş and Serkan scramble to find Kerem.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Just as Güneş and Serkan start to move on with their lives, Kerem's news reunites the former couple.
